name: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Reflector
tagline: REFLECTIVE MARKER FOR GRASS AND GRAVEL PAVER MODULES
summary: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Reflector is a reflective road marker designed to demarcate emergency vehicle accessways on permeable and green pathways. Reflective road marker housing units are manufactured from polypropylene (PP) and raise reflective road markers to increase visibility. SikaRoof® TurfPave® Reflector modules are push-fitted into any cell on SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD.

items.text: Singapore Green Building Product (Leader) Cert. No. SGBP 3255

items.label: Shelf life
items.text: No expiration date if the product is stored in accordance to the storage conditions as stated in this Product Data Sheet

items.label: Storage conditions
items.text: Product must be stored in their original packing, laid in a horizontal position, and under cool and dry conditions. The product must be protected from direct sunlight, rain, snow and ice, and any other elements

items.label: APPLICATION
items.text: SikaRoof® TurfPave® Reflector shall be fitted with a 100 x 100 mm reflective road marker secured by two screws and nuts. The module would then be push-fitted into pre-determined cells of SikaRoof® TurfPave® XD to create the desired design according to specifications.
